load_ip_adapter_IPAdapterMixin: load IP Adapter weights and image encoder into a Stable Diffusion pipeline from a pretrained model path or state dict
set_ip_adapter_scale_IPAdapterMixin: set per-block IP Adapter scale values to control image prompt influence on generation
unload_ip_adapter_IPAdapterMixin: unload IP Adapter weights and restore original UNet attention processors
load_ip_adapter_FluxIPAdapterMixin: load IP Adapter weights and image encoder into a Flux transformer model from a pretrained model path or state dict
set_ip_adapter_scale_FluxIPAdapterMixin: set per-layer IP Adapter scale values for Flux transformer blocks with support for multiple adapters
